physics-m2-c.title: [Falanqaynta wareegga] Laba iska

physics-m2-c.material: [Falanqaynta wareegga] Laba iska caabbin oo 6 Ω iyo 3 Ω ah ayaa si parallel ah loo xiray, kadibna loo xiray magaalo danab ah 12 V. Waa imisa wadarta korontada ku socota wareeggan oo dhan?

physics-m2-q5.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
physics-m2-q5.material: Thermos-ka ka ilaaliya cabitaannada kulul muddo dheer wuxuu leeyahay 'faaruq' u dhexeeya labadiisa gidaar iyo 'dahab-qurxin lacag ah' gidaarka gudaha. Doodee ayaa si sax ah isugu xidhay sifo kasta iyo nooca gudbinta kulaylka ee ay xannibto?

physics-killer-08.title: Muon ka dhashay jawiga
physics-killer-08.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
physics-killer-08.material: Muon ka dhashay jawiga sare ayaa si toosan hoos ugu socda dhulka xawaare $0.8c$. Qaab-dhismeedka Dhulka (dhulka) barta soo saarista waxay joogtaa dherer $800\,\mathrm{m}$, iyo cimriga celceliska muon-ka ee lagu cabbiray qaab-dhismeedkiisa nasashada waa $2.0\,\mu\mathrm{s}$.
